body: H1 reference preparation, for the Admiral's reading. It returned at 11:42 with a checked METHOD blocker, not a physical failure: the base branch and the Fourier mode tail could not be certified over the frozen load range, so no reference interval exists yet. Una (XO) verified every derivation and agreed all 35 gate dispositions: 13 conditional passes, 21 unbound, and one fail that is Una's own. The blind plot box's upper edge was rounded inward. That narrowed nothing, because the hull comes from the builder's reading, [0.587, 0.634]. Cost: 1851 of the funded 10200 seat-budget seconds; the other 8349 retired. I accepted the blocker and the closures, with their unmeasured parts named, and the route continues. Sciences now prepares one card for Una's lead: a validated closed-form bound on the base branch. Before pricing, it must show on paper that the bound can reach its target (M_W < 2.82), since the existing estimate gives 6.81. It is due 10-20 16:00, after the native R2 design at noon. Nothing runs before I rule a card. No stall pause; the 10-22 report and diagnosis stay due. Map count 0.
